evidence_note: Opened 2026-10-07: WMKY (Morehead State Public Radio), 'Flemingsburg Wind Project Discontinued', by Marla Toncray & The Ledger Independent, May 10, 2014. Mason County Judge-Executive James L. 'Buddy' Gallenstein received a copy of a letter to the Kentucky Public Service Commission from Duke Energy Renewables, signed by Milton R. Howard, 'to document Duke Energy Renewables' intent to discontinue the Flemingsburg Wind Project that was being studied for possible development in Mason and Fleming counties', adding 'the project's likelihood of success is marginal'. The article dates receipt to Thursday (May 8) in one paragraph and Friday (May 9) in another; evidence_date stays 2014-05. The letter as quoted gives no reason beyond a marginal likelihood of success; the article says the project 'has divided the May's Lick community for nearly a year'. The record's 'due to local opposition' comes from the Sabin report, not this document. Not read: the Ledger Independent follow-up (maysville-online.com redirects to www.maysville-online.com, still refused by the network policy).
